shloka_text: विसृज्य च महाबाहुर्ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् । भ्रातृभिः सहितो रामः प्रमुमोद सुखं सुखी ।। 7.41.1 ।।
transliteration: visṛjya ca mahābāhurṛkṣavānararākṣasān | bhrātṛbhiḥ sahito rāmaḥ pramumoda sukhaṃ sukhī || 7.41.1 ||
translation: विसृज्य having dismissed, च and, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed one, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसान् the bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सहितः accompanied, रामः Rama, प्रमुमोद rejoiced greatly, सुखं happily, सुखी happy
explanation: And the mighty-armed Rama, having dismissed the bears, monkeys, and Rakshasas, was very happy and rejoiced greatly along with his brothers.
comments: The Pushpaka chariot, released by Kubera, returns and offers itself to Rama, who worships and dismisses it, bidding it come whenever summoned -- Bharata then tells how, under Rama's righteous reign, no disease or untimely death afflicts the people, the rains and seasons are auspicious, and the citizens pray that such a king be immortal.

shloka_text: अथापराह्णसमये भ्रातृभिः सह राघवः । शुश्राव मधुरां वाणीमन्तरिक्षात् प्रभाषिताम् ।। 7.41.2 ।।
transliteration: athāparāhṇasamaye bhrātṛbhiḥ saha rāghavaḥ | śuśrāva madhurāṃ vāṇīmantarikṣāt prabhāṣitām || 7.41.2 ||
translation: अथ then, अपराह्णसमये in the afternoon, भ्रातृभिः with his brothers, सह together with, राघवः Rama, शुश्राव he heard, मधुरां a sweet, वाणीं voice, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, प्रभाषिताम् spoken
explanation: Then, in the afternoon, Rama, along with his brothers, heard a sweet voice spoken from the sky.

shloka_text: सौम्य राम निरीक्षस्व सौम्येन वदनेन माम् । कुबेरभवनात्प्राप्तं विद्धि मां पुष्पकं प्रभो ।। 7.41.3 ।।
transliteration: saumya rāma nirīkṣasva saumyena vadanena mām | kuberabhavanātprāptaṃ viddhi māṃ puṣpakaṃ prabho || 7.41.3 ||
translation: सौम्य O gentle one, राम O Rama, निरीक्षस्व look at, सौम्येन with a gentle, वदनेन face, माम् me, कुबेरभवनात् from Kubera's abode, प्राप्तम् arrived, विद्धि know, माम् me, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, प्रभो O Lord.
explanation: O gentle Rama, look at me with a gentle face; know me, O Lord, to be the Pushpaka chariot that has arrived from Kubera's abode.

shloka_text: तव शासनमाज्ञाय गतो ऽस्मि भवनं प्रति । उपस्थातुं नरश्रेष्ठ स च मां प्रत्यभाषत ।। 7.41.4 ।।
transliteration: tava śāsanamājñāya gato 'smi bhavanaṃ prati | upasthātuṃ naraśreṣṭha sa ca māṃ pratyabhāṣata || 7.41.4 ||
translation: तव your, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having understood, गतः अस्मि I have gone, भवनम् abode, प्रति towards, उपस्थातुम् to serve, नरश्रेष्ठ O best among men, सः he, च and, माम् to me, प्रत्यभाषत replied.
explanation: O best among men, having understood your command, I went to his abode to serve, and he (Kubera) spoke to me in return.

shloka_text: निर्जितस्त्वं नरेन्द्रेण राघवेण महात्मना । निहत्य युधि दुर्धर्षं रावणं राक्षसेश्वरम् ।। 7.41.5 ।।
transliteration: nirjitastvaṃ narendreṇa rāghaveṇa mahātmanā | nihatya yudhi durdharṣaṃ rāvaṇaṃ rākṣaseśvaram || 7.41.5 ||
translation: निर्जितः conquered, त्वम् you, नरेन्द्रेण by the king, राघवेण by Rama, महात्मना by the great-souled one, निहत्य having killed, युधि in battle, दुर्धर्षम् formidable, रावणम् Ravana, राक्षसेश्वरम् the lord of Rakshasas.
explanation: He said, "You have been conquered by the great-souled king Rama, the descendant of Raghu, who slew the formidable Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, in battle."

shloka_text: ममापि परमा प्रीतर्हते तस्मिन्दुरात्मनि । रावणे सगणे चैव सपुत्रे सहबान्धवे ।। 7.41.6 ।।
transliteration: mamāpi paramā prītarhate tasmindurātmani | rāvaṇe sagaṇe caiva saputre sahabāndhave || 7.41.6 ||
translation: मम my, अपि also, परमा supreme, प्रीतिः joy, हते when killed, तस्मिन् that, दुरात्मनि evil-minded one, रावणे Ravana, सगणे with his retinue, च and, एव indeed, सपुत्रे with his sons, सहबान्धवे with his relatives.
explanation: He further said, "My supreme joy also arises from the killing of that evil-minded Ravana, along with his retinue, sons, and relatives."

shloka_text: स त्वं रामेण लङ्कायां निर्जितः परमात्मना । वह सौम्य तमेव त्वमहमाज्ञापयामि ते ।। 7.41.7 ।।
transliteration: sa tvaṃ rāmeṇa laṅkāyāṃ nirjitaḥ paramātmanā | vaha saumya tameva tvamahamājñāpayāmi te || 7.41.7 ||
translation: सः that, त्वम् you, रामेण by Rama, लङ्कायाम् in Lanka, निर्जितः conquered, परमात्मना by the supreme soul, वह carry, सौम्य O gentle one, तम् him, एव indeed, त्वम् you, अहम् I, आज्ञपयामि command, ते you.
explanation: He concluded, "Therefore, O gentle Pushpaka, since you were conquered by the supreme Rama in Lanka, you must carry him; I command you to do so."

shloka_text: परमो ह्येष मे कामो यत्त्वं राघवनन्दनम् । वहेर्लोकस्य संयानं गच्छस्व विगतज्वरः ।। 7.41.8 ।।
transliteration: paramo hyeṣa me kāmo yattvaṃ rāghavanandanam | vaherlokasya saṃyānaṃ gacchasva vigatajvaraḥ || 7.41.8 ||
translation: परमो supreme, हि indeed, एष this, मे my, कामो desire, यत् that, त्वं you, राघवनन्दनम् Rama, वहेः should carry, लोकस्य of the people, संयानं the journey, गच्छस्व go, विगतज्वरः free from distress.
explanation: This is indeed my greatest desire, that you should carry Rama and the people on their journey; therefore, go forth without any anxiety.

shloka_text: सो ऽहं शासनमाज्ञाय धनदस्य महात्मनः । त्वत्सकाशमनुप्राप्तो निर्विशङ्कः प्रतीक्ष माम् ।। 7.41.9 ।।
transliteration: so 'haṃ śāsanamājñāya dhanadasya mahātmanaḥ | tvatsakāśamanuprāpto nirviśaṅkaḥ pratīkṣa mām || 7.41.9 ||
translation: सो that, अहं I, शासनम् command, आज्ञाय having understood, धनदस्य of Kubera, महात्मनः the great-souled, त्वत्सकाशम् to your presence, अनुप्राप्तो arrived, निर्विशङ्कः without doubt, प्रतीक्ष wait for, माम् me.
explanation: Having understood the command of the great-souled Kubera, I have arrived in your presence; therefore, wait for me without any apprehension.

shloka_text: अदृष्यः सर्वभूतानां सर्वेषां धनदाज्ञया । चराम्यहं प्रभावेण तवाज्ञां परिपालयन् ।। 7.41.10 ।।
transliteration: adṛṣyaḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ sarveṣāṃ dhanadājñayā | carāmyahaṃ prabhāveṇa tavājñāṃ paripālayan || 7.41.10 ||
translation: अदृष्यः invisible, सर्वभूतानां to all beings, सर्वेषां to all, धनदाज्ञया by Kubera's command, चरामि I move, अहं I, प्रभावेण by my power, तवाज्ञां your command, परिपालयन् obeying.
explanation: By Kubera's command, I am invisible to all beings and I move by my own power, obeying your command.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तस्तदा रामः पुष्पकेण महाबलः । उवाच पुष्पकं दृष्ट्वा विमानं पुनरागतम् ।। 7.41.11 ।।
transliteration: evamuktastadā rāmaḥ puṣpakeṇa mahābalaḥ | uvāca puṣpakaṃ dṛṣṭvā vimānaṃ punarāgatam || 7.41.11 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः addressed, तदा then, रामः Rama, पुष्पकेण by Pushpaka, महाबलः the mighty, उवाच spoke, पुष्पकं Pushpaka, दृष्ट्वा having seen, विमानं the aerial car, पुनरागतम् returned again.
explanation: Thus addressed by Pushpaka, the mighty Rama then spoke, having seen the Pushpaka aerial car returned again.

shloka_text: यद्येवं स्वागतं ते ऽस्तु विमानवर पुष्पक । आनुकूल्याद्धनेशस्य वृत्तदोषो न नो भवेत् ।। 7.41.12 ।।
transliteration: yadyevaṃ svāgataṃ te 'stu vimānavara puṣpaka | ānukūlyāddhaneśasya vṛttadoṣo na no bhavet || 7.41.12 ||
translation: यदि if, एवम् so, स्वागतं welcome, ते to you, अस्तु let it be, विमानवर O best of aerial cars, पुष्पक Pushpaka, आनुकूल्यात् due to the favor, धनेशस्य of Kubera, वृत्तदोषो fault in conduct, न not, नः our, भवेत् may it be.
explanation: If it is so, then welcome to you, O best of aerial cars, Pushpaka; due to the favor of Kubera, no impropriety shall befall us.

shloka_text: लाजैश्चैव तथा पुष्पैर्धूपैश्चैव सुगन्धिभिः । पूजयित्वा महाबाहू राघवः पुष्पकं तदा ।। 7.41.13 ।।
transliteration: lājaiścaiva tathā puṣpairdhūpaiścaiva sugandhibhiḥ | pūjayitvā mahābāhū rāghavaḥ puṣpakaṃ tadā || 7.41.13 ||
translation: लाजैः with parched grains, च and, एव indeed, तथा similarly, पुष्पैः with flowers, धूपैः with incense, च and, एव indeed, सुगन्धिभिः fragrant, पूजयित्वा having worshipped, महाबाहू the mighty-armed one, राघवः Rama, पुष्पकम् the Pushpaka, तदा then.
explanation: Then, the mighty-armed Rama worshipped the Pushpaka chariot with parched grains, flowers, and fragrant incense.

shloka_text: गम्यतामिति चोवाच आगच्छ त्वं स्मरे यदा । सिद्धानां च गतौ सौम्य मा विषादेन योजय । प्रतिघातश्च ते मा भूद्यथेष्टं गच्छतो दिशः ।। 7.41.14 ।।
transliteration: gamyatāmiti covāca āgaccha tvaṃ smare yadā | siddhānāṃ ca gatau saumya mā viṣādena yojaya | pratighātaśca te mā bhūdyatheṣṭaṃ gacchato diśaḥ || 7.41.14 ||
translation: गम्यताम् let it go, इति thus, च and, उवाच he said, आगच्छ come, त्वम् you, स्मरे remember, यदा when, सिद्धानाम् of the Siddhas, च and, गतौ in flight, सौम्य O gentle one, मा do not, विषादेन with sorrow, योजय afflict, प्रतिघातः obstruction, च and, ते to you, मा do not, भूत् let it be, यथेष्टम् as desired, गच्छतः going, दिशः directions.
explanation: Rama then told the Pushpaka, "Depart now, and remember to return whenever I recall you; O gentle one, do not be afflicted with sorrow, and may there be no obstruction to your desired flight in any direction, like that of the Siddhas."

shloka_text: एवमस्त्विति रामेण पूजयित्वा विसर्जितम् । अभिप्रेतां दिशं तस्मात्प्रायात्तत्पुष्पकं तदा ।। 7.41.15 ।।
transliteration: evamastviti rāmeṇa pūjayitvā visarjitam | abhipretāṃ diśaṃ tasmātprāyāttatpuṣpakaṃ tadā || 7.41.15 ||
translation: एवम् thus, अस्तु let it be, इति thus, रामेण by Rama, पूजयित्वा having worshipped, विसर्जितम् dismissed, अभिप्रेताम् desired, दिशम् direction, तस्मात् from there, प्रायात् departed, तत् that, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, तदा then.
explanation: Having been worshipped and dismissed by Rama with the words "So be it," the Pushpaka then departed from there towards its desired direction.

shloka_text: एवमन्तर्हिते तस्मिन्पुष्पके सुकृतात्मनि । भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्वाक्यमुवाच रघुनन्दनम् ।। 7.41.16 ।।
transliteration: evamantarhite tasminpuṣpake sukṛtātmani | bharataḥ prāñjalirvākyamuvāca raghunandanam || 7.41.16 ||
translation: एवम् thus, अन्तर्हिते having disappeared, तस्मिन् that, पुष्पके Pushpaka, सुकृतात्मनि of good deeds, भरतः Bharata, प्राञ्जलिः with folded hands, वाक्यम् words, उवाच spoke, रघुनन्दनम् to Rama.
explanation: After that Pushpaka, which was of good deeds, had thus disappeared, Bharata, with folded hands, spoke these words to Rama.

shloka_text: विविधात्मनि दृश्यन्ते त्वयि वीर प्रशासति । अमानुषाणां सत्त्वानां व्याहृतानि मुहुर्मुहुः ।। 7.41.17 ।।
transliteration: vividhātmani dṛśyante tvayi vīra praśāsati | amānuṣāṇāṃ sattvānāṃ vyāhṛtāni muhurmuhuḥ || 7.41.17 ||
translation: विविधात्मनि in various forms, दृश्यन्ते are seen, त्वयि in you, वीर O hero, प्रशासति ruling, अमानुषाणाम् of non-human, सत्त्वानाम् beings, व्याहृतानि utterances, मुहुर्मुहुः repeatedly.
explanation: O hero, while you rule, the utterances of non-human beings are repeatedly seen in various forms.

shloka_text: अनामयश्च सत्वानां साग्रो मासो गतो ह्ययम् । जीर्णानामपि सत्त्वानां मृत्युर्नायाति राघव ।। 7.41.18 ।।
transliteration: anāmayaśca satvānāṃ sāgro māso gato hyayam | jīrṇānāmapi sattvānāṃ mṛtyurnāyāti rāghava || 7.41.18 ||
translation: अनामयः without disease, च and, सत्वानां of beings, साग्रः full, मासः month, गतः passed, हि indeed, अयम् this, जीर्णानाम् of the old, अपि even, सत्त्वानां of beings, मृत्युः death, न not, आयाति comes, राघव O Raghava.
explanation: O Raghava, this full month has passed without any disease among beings, and even for the aged, death does not come.

shloka_text: अरोगप्रसवा नार्यो वपुष्मन्तो हि मानवाः । हर्षश्चाभ्यधिको राजञ्जनस्य पुरवासिनः ।। 7.41.19 ।।
transliteration: arogaprasavā nāryo vapuṣmanto hi mānavāḥ | harṣaścābhyadhiko rājañjanasya puravāsinaḥ || 7.41.19 ||
translation: अरोगप्रसवाः giving birth without illness, नार्यः women, वपुष्मन्तः healthy, हि indeed, मानवाः humans, हर्षः joy, च and, अभ्यधिकः excessive, राजन् O King, जनस्य of the people, पुरवासिनः of the city dwellers.
explanation: Women give birth without illness, humans are healthy, and O King, the joy of the city dwellers is exceedingly great.

shloka_text: काले वर्षति पर्जन्यः पातयन्नमृतं पयः । वाताश्चापि प्रवान्त्येते स्पर्शयुक्ताः सुखाः शिवाः ।। 7.41.20 ।।
transliteration: kāle varṣati parjanyaḥ pātayannamṛtaṃ payaḥ | vātāścāpi pravāntyete sparśayuktāḥ sukhāḥ śivāḥ || 7.41.20 ||
translation: काले at the proper time, वर्षति rains, पर्जन्यः the cloud, पातयन् causing to fall, अमृतं nectar-like, पयः water, वाताः winds, च and, अपि also, प्रवान्ति blow, एते these, स्पर्शयुक्ताः endowed with pleasant touch, सुखाः pleasant, शिवाः auspicious.
explanation: The clouds rain nectar-like water at the proper time, and these winds blow, pleasant to the touch, agreeable, and auspicious.

shloka_text: ईदृशो ऽनश्वरो राजा भवेदिति नरेश्वरः । कथयन्ति पुरे राजन्पौरजानपदास्तथा ।। 7.41.21 ।।
transliteration: īdṛśo 'naśvaro rājā bhavediti nareśvaraḥ | kathayanti pure rājanpaurajānapadāstathā || 7.41.21 ||
translation: ईदृशः such, अनश्वरः immortal, राजा king, भवेत् may be, इति thus, नरेश्वरः O King, कथयन्ति say, पुरे in the city, राजन् O King, पौरजानपदाः city and country dwellers, तथा also.
explanation: O King, the city and country dwellers say in the city, "May such a king be immortal!"

shloka_text: एता वाचः सुमधुरा भरतेन समीरिताः । श्रुत्वा रामो मुदा युक्तो बभूव नृपसत्तमः ।। 7.41.22 ।।
transliteration: etā vācaḥ sumadhurā bharatena samīritāḥ | śrutvā rāmo mudā yukto babhūva nṛpasattamaḥ || 7.41.22 ||
translation: एता these, वाचः words, सुमधुरा very sweet, भरतेन by Bharata, समीरिताः spoken, श्रुत्वा having heard, रामः Rama, मुदा with joy, युक्तः filled, बभूव became, नृपसत्तमः the best of kings.
explanation: Having heard these very sweet words spoken by Bharata, Rama, the best of kings, became filled with joy. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकचत्वारिंशः सर्गः ।। 41 ।। Thus ends the forty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
